title: The Best Way To Use AI To Achieve ANY Goal
description:
"The greatest use case for AI is not using it as an assistant.”

True leverage happens when you force the system to act as a strategic thought partner and interview you instead.

By giving it an expert role and making it ask you 3 to 5 deep context questions, you unlock non-obvious solutions to your biggest bottlenecks.
